about: The v4 binding's constraint spec. Every constraint of constraints.md is tied here to the properties that state it, its code, its pins and its fuzz data, and every property to its model, its conformance suite and its steps in general.tla. runner/tests/test_v4_bindings.py holds each tie to the tree and re-measures the fuzz part.
